result.instructions: Tools for LeagueApps, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which programs are open for registration on our site right now?"; "Show the full game schedule for our spring soccer league."; "List the teams in program 2420094 and their divisions.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes LeagueApps data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run leagueapps_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run leagueapps_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run leagueapps_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. leagueapps_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: leagueapps_get_site
tools.title: Get site info
tools.description: Basic information about the connected LeagueApps site: name, subdomain, time zone, URL, logo and theme colors. Public API: GET /v1/sites/{siteId}.

tools.name: leagueapps_list_programs
tools.title: List programs
tools.description: List programs (leagues, clubs, camps, tournaments, classes) with full details. Choose states with include_states (LIVE, UPCOMING, COMPLETED, DRAFT). Public API: GET /programs.

include_states.description: Program states to include (default: the vendor default).

tools.name: leagueapps_list_current_programs
tools.title: List current programs
tools.description: List the programs that are open now or upcoming on the site. Good first call to see what the organization runs. Public API: GET /programs/current.

include_deleted.description: Also return programs that were deleted.

tools.name: leagueapps_get_program
tools.title: Get a program
tools.description: Full details of one program by id: dates, description, pricing, registration state, location. Public API: GET /programs/{programId}.

program_id.description: Program id (programId from a program list).

tools.name: leagueapps_get_program_schedule
tools.title: Get a program schedule
tools.description: The full schedule of a program: games with teams, times, locations and scores, plus events and date notes. Public API: GET /programs/{programId}/schedule.

tools.name: leagueapps_list_program_teams
tools.title: List program teams
tools.description: List the teams of a program with division, status and team profile URL. Public API: GET /programs/{programId}/teams.

tools.name: leagueapps_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List the fields, facilities and venues the site uses, with address and sub-locations. Public API: GET /locations.

tools.name: leagueapps_get_location
tools.title: Get a location
tools.description: Details of one location by id: address, coordinates and sub-locations. Public API: GET /locations/{locationId}.

location_id.description: Location id (locationId from a schedule or location list).

tools.name: leagueapps_list_sports
tools.title: List sports
tools.description: List the sports that have LIVE or UPCOMING programs on the site (sports with only completed programs are not listed). Public API: GET /sports.

tools.name: leagueapps_list_announcements
tools.title: List announcements
tools.description: Site announcements, newest first. Public API: GET /announcements.

tools.name: leagueapps_list_blog_posts
tools.title: List blog posts
tools.description: Blog posts of the site, newest first, with title, summary and URL. Public API: GET /blog.
